# HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers

> Compile-time Roslyn analyzers and code fixes for .NET HttpClient, IHttpClientFactory, AddHttpClient typed and named clients, Polly, and Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience. Analyzer-only: no application runtime dependency.

The package catches outbound HTTP reliability bugs at build time, including socket exhaustion, missing PooledConnectionLifetime, typed-client lifetime leaks, unsafe POST retries, custom pipelines retrying unsafe methods, concurrent hedging of unsafe methods, undisposed responses, and dropped cancellation tokens.

## Rules

- [HCR001](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR001/): Do not create and dispose HttpClient per request
- [HCR002](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR002/): Long-lived HttpClient should set PooledConnectionLifetime
- [HCR003](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR003/): Do not cache IHttpClientFactory.CreateClient() results
- [HCR004](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR004/): Do not inject typed HttpClient clients into singletons
- [HCR005](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR005/): Duplicate typed-client registrations
- [HCR020](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR020/): DelegatingHandler capturing scoped request data
- [HCR040](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR040/): Duplicate resilience handlers
- [HCR041](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR041/): AddStandardResilienceHandler retrying unsafe HTTP methods
- [HCR042](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR042/): AddStandardHedgingHandler replaying unsafe HTTP methods
- [HCR043](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR043/): AddResilienceHandler retrying unsafe HTTP methods
- [HCR060](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR060/): Dispose ResponseHeadersRead responses
- [HCR061](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR061/): Check HTTP success before reading content
- [HCR062](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR062/): Per-request DefaultRequestHeaders mutation
- [HCR063](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR063/): Sync-over-async around outbound HTTP
- [HCR064](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR064/): Missing CancellationToken on HttpClient calls
- [HCR080](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR080/): Unbounded HTTP fan-out
- [HCR081](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR081/): Undisposed HTTP content streams
- [HCR082](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR082/): Per-request resilience pipeline construction
- [HCR083](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR083/): Relative URLs without BaseAddress
- [HCR084](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR084/): Duplicated named-client string literals
- [HCR085](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers/rules/HCR085/): Implicit typed-client name collisions
